features.name: Catalog
features.description: Products, categories with SEO text, brands, attributes, media in the merchant's own storage, search, listings and filters, the product page and the catalog admin widget.

features.name: Variants
features.description: Options such as size or colour, each variant with its own price, stock and SKU.

features.name: Size charts
features.description: Size charts in inches or centimetres with fit advice, shown on product pages from the product, its brand or its category.

features.name: Multi-location stock
features.description: Stock kept per location (warehouses, shops); orders take stock from the first location that has it.

features.name: Grades and serials
features.description: Condition grades for used or refurbished items and serial numbers (such as IMEI) captured per unit when an order is packed.

features.name: Digital goods
features.description: Downloads and licence keys, given to the shopper once the order is paid.

features.name: Bookings
features.description: Services booked in simple slots: a duration, weekly hours and no double booking.

features.name: Cart and checkout
features.description: The cart, checkout, orders with merchant-defined statuses, couriers with tracking links, customer records and the success page.

features.name: Cash on delivery
features.description: Cash on delivery with a confirmation step, a largest order value, an optional advance, a blocklist and return-to-origin flags.

features.name: Delivery zones
features.description: Delivery fees by city or area, free delivery over an amount, and store pickup.

features.name: Courier APIs
features.description: Book shipments with a courier's API using the merchant's own keys and read the latest tracking status.

features.name: Taxes
features.description: Simple tax rules: a percentage per category or region, prices shown with or without tax.

features.name: Coupons
features.description: Codes for a percentage or fixed amount off, with limits, dates and conditions.

features.name: Deals
features.description: Automatic offers on products, categories or brands, with dates and use limits.

features.name: Loyalty
features.description: Points earned on delivered orders and redeemed at checkout, with expiry and a history.

features.name: Role pricing
features.description: Signed-in shoppers with a listed Accounts role get a percent off the goods after offers, shown as its own line on quotes, orders and invoices.

features.name: Bundles
features.description: Bundles and buy X get Y offers applied in the cart.

features.name: Reviews
features.description: Ratings and reviews from shoppers whose order was delivered, with moderation.

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Shoppers save products to their wishlist.

features.name: Alerts
features.description: Back-in-stock and price-drop alerts sent through Notifications.

features.name: Compare
features.description: Shoppers compare products side by side.

features.name: Returns
features.description: Return and warranty claims with time windows per item and grade, photos, approval, refunds and restocking exactly once.

features.name: Invoices
features.description: Invoices and packing slips, with the serial numbers on each line.

features.name: CSV
features.description: Import and export products and stock, export orders, as CSV.

features.name: Bulk actions
features.description: Change prices, stock, status or category for many products at once, and move many orders at once.

features.name: Reports
features.description: Sales by product, category, brand and city, stock age, return rate and margin.

features.name: Events
features.description: Order, return, review, catalog and stock events for your server: listed by the API and sent to your webhooks through Notifications.

features.name: Staff alerts
features.description: E-mail or WhatsApp your staff about new orders, status changes, payments, transfer proofs, cancels, expiries and return claims, through Notifications.

features.name: SEO
features.description: Meta tags and structured data for products and categories, and sitemaps.

features.name: Landing pages
features.description: Category, brand and grade landing pages with their own copy, indexed while enough products are in stock, and glossary pages of attributes and grades.

features.name: Feeds
features.description: Product feeds for shopping and social catalogues.

features.name: AI copy
features.description: Product descriptions and meta text written with the merchant's own AI key.

features.name: llms.txt
features.description: An llms.txt of the catalog for AI assistants.

features.name: Import
features.description: Catalog, customers, orders, promotions, loyalty and shopper records moved in from another system with ss-import (server token only; no messages, events or alerts). Our admins switch it on for a migration and off after it.
